inputs.name: importAnalytics.root
inputs.description: Path to the repository tree to scan; it is passed through resolve and used to look for specification/loops at each project while recursing into child directories. Traversal skips hidden directories and node_modules, dist, build, and analytics.

inputs.name: importAnalytics.historical
inputs.description: Marks generated analytics events as historical, and the value is copied into each event. If omitted, it defaults to true; it does not filter which loop states or trace records are read.

outputs.name: importAnalytics
outputs.description: Count of generated events from loops whose per-loop processing completed, accumulated after their events are passed to recordImported. It includes loop creation, completed steps and loops, and recognized loop.evaluated trace records; per-loop failures are logged and excluded from the count.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The promise can reject if opening the analytics repository, resolving or traversing the root, computing project identity, reconciling history, or closing the repository fails. Individual loop read, parse, and event-recording failures are caught and logged, and a missing or unreadable specification/loops directory is treated as empty.
